answer: Require every new identity to lock a small bond for ten epochs, and release its first rewards only after peers with no prior transaction history attest its work. A sybil farm then pays the bond per fake, a cost that stacks like timber, while earning nothing until unrelated graders vouch. Graph clustering flags the plume of fresh accounts that only attest each other, so a nebula of clones earns zero and forfeits its bonds.
